description:
The two plots share the same x-axis and y-axis. The x-axis is labeled "Steps", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 500, and has tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 for the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 for the bottom plot. 

The top plot illustrates the training rewards for the "Easy Training Set", comparing two models, Llama-On-Policy-Easy and Llama-LUFFY-Easy, across 500 steps. The Llama-On-Policy-Easy line is teal, solid, and has a shaded region around it, starting at approximately 0.05 and increasing to around 0.3 at 500 steps, with some fluctuations. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy line is red, solid, and also has a shaded region, beginning at 0.0, rising to about 0.35 at 500 steps, and showing some variation.

The bottom plot shows the training rewards for the "Hard Training Set", comparing Llama-On-Policy-Hard and Llama-LUFFY-Hard across 500 steps. The Llama-On-Policy-Hard line is teal, solid, and has a shaded region, starting at 0.0, peaking at around 0.05 at 100 steps, and then declining to nearly 0.0 by 500 steps. The Llama-LUFFY-Hard line is red, solid, and has a shaded region, beginning at 0.0, increasing to approximately 0.15 at 200 steps, and then continuing to rise to around 0.2 by 500 steps.
